title: Comparative CI for INT8 weight-only profiles with FP8 backstop and GPTQ/AWQ accuracy gates
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: We have multiple INT8 weight-only (wo) quantization paths in the codebase (GPTQ and AWQ variants) and an emerging FP8 fast-path we want as a safety backstop for difficult models. Current coverage focuses on unit-level calibration but lacks an automated comparative pipeline that evaluates accuracy regressions, numerical drift, and quality/loss trade-offs across quant modes before rollout.

Objective: Build a CI-driven comparative evaluation harness that: (1) runs nightly cross-quant comparisons (FP32 baseline vs INT8(GPTQ) vs INT8(AWQ) vs FP8 backstop) on a curated golden set, (2) computes stability and quality signals (probability-log-delta, token match rate, semantic-similarity via embeddings, task metrics for QA/LLM generation), (3) gates PRs and canary rollouts with configurable thresholds, and (4) integrates telemetry and automated alerting when thresholds are breached.

Scope:
- Include weight-only INT8 workflows (GPTQ + AWQ) plus an FP8 fallback/indicator path.
- Focus on integration-level CI and regression detection rather than microkernel optimization.
- Cover a balanced golden sample set (see Dataset section) and representative latency/cost metrics.

Non-goals: full-scale production retraining or model architecture changes, replacing existing per-model accuracy labs, or adding additional quantization formats beyond FP8/INT8.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Nightly CI job that runs 10 model+workload combos and publishes a summary within 2 hours.
2) For each model run, show FP32 baseline and deltas for: token-level match rate, top-token probability delta (avg + 95th percentile), embedding cosine delta, and task-specific metric (e.g., SQuAD F1 for QA models, BLEU/ROUGE for generation where applicable).
3) PR-level pre-merge checks run a lighter subset (3 model combos, <= 20 minutes) and block merges when any metric exceeds configured thresholds.
4) Canary rollout integration that will automatically revert to prior model variant if a 24-hour rolling regression above threshold is detected.

Datasets / golden set:
- Open-domain generation prompts: 800 prompts sampled across lengths and domains (short, medium, long).
- QA set: 5k examples from SQuAD + internal long-context QA probes.
- Instruction-following: 1k instruction variants used in product regressions.
- Edge cases: 200 adversarial prompts to expose quantization-sensitive tokens/patterns.

Metrics and thresholds (initial):
- Token match rate: regression threshold 0.8% absolute decrease vs FP32.
- Avg logprob delta: allow up to 0.15 nats avg; 95th percentile <= 0.5.
- Embedding cosine delta: mean decrease <= 0.005 (semantic similarity).
- Task metric regressions (F1/ROUGE/BLEU): no more than 1% relative drop.
- Latency: p95 increase <= 10% and cost-per-token reduction reported.

Implementation plan:
1) CI pipelines: create two pipelines: PR-fast-check (3 models, 20m budget) and Nightly-deep (10 models, 2h budget). Use existing CI runner fleet with GPU tag "quant-validate".
2) Harness: reusable runner that accepts a model variant, quant profile, and dataset shard; outputs standardized JSON metrics and a golden-answer diff.
3) Comparison engine: service that ingests outputs and computes deltas, summary trend lines, and an overall pass/fail signal based on weighted metrics.
4) Telemetry: integrate with Console dashboards (per-model metric trends) and send alerts to #quant-ops Slack when nightly job fails gating thresholds.
5) Canary flow: wire the pass/fail signal into rollout automation; when a canary fails, trigger automated rollback + incident ticket creation.

Operational runbook:
- Nightly alert: triage owner inspects diff artifacts, checks PRs touching quant pipeline, tags suspected root-cause (calibration table, kernel swap, model mismatch).
- Quick rollback: how to pin to previous quant profile in Dedicated/private customers.
- Investigation checklist: reproduce locally with the same seeds, compare float32 logits, check calibration histograms, examine per-layer quant scales.

Risk & mitigation:
- Flaky tests from sampling variance: use fixed seeds and deterministic tokenization; report bootstrap confidence intervals.
- False positives from long-tail prompts: have separate tolerance for adversarial bucket and weigh it lower in overall gate.

Deliverables:
- CI jobs and a reusable test harness plugin (Python/Go) with config for quant profile matrix.
- Comparison service + dashboard tiles in Console for per-model deltas.
- Canary integration and rollback playbook.

Success metrics: reduced post-deploy regressions due to quant changes by 70% in the next quarter; PR merges blocked early by pre-merge checks rather than post-deploy incident remediation.
